about: The context of Birkhoff: for each join-irreducible j, the
meet-irreducibles m with j ≤ m. Both cards of a debit are derived
from this table. A file that only checked a chain would hide that
the two faces are different sets — on a chain they look like shifts
The trap: treating joins() as the old debits() (JI only) and never

coverage.criterion: a chain (faces look like shifts) and M3 (faces coincide as sets, incidence is the identity)
